 When is Black Friday?
 Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, Nov. 27, the day after Thanksgiving. Black Friday is known for major discounts on electronics, appliances, home goods and more. Cyber Monday follows on Nov. 30, giving shoppers another opportunity to save.
 When will Black Friday sales kick off?
 Although Black Friday officially takes place on Nov. 27, many retailers have started offering discounts weeks in advance. Best Buy’s Black Friday sale , for example, kicked off before Halloween, on Nov. 12. Amazon ‘s Black Friday Sale kicks off on Nov. 19 and runs for 12 days through Nov. 30. Daily themed price drops will let you save on your favorite products each day.
 Should I wait until Black Friday to shop?
 It depends on what you’re buying. If you spot a product at a record-low price or a discount that matches its previous best, there’s not much reason to wait, especially if it’s a popular item that could sell out . However, some products, particularly TVs , laptops and other big-ticket electronics, may see bigger discounts closer to Black Friday.
 Which retailers will run Black Friday sales?
 Most major retailers participate in Black Friday, including Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy and more. You’ll also find deals directly from brands like Ninja, LG and Samsung. Many retailers offer both online and in-store deals, giving you plenty of ways to shop.
 Are Black Friday sales better in person or online?
 Both can offer excellent savings, but shopping online is often more convenient and makes it easier to compare prices across retailers. Many of the biggest Black Friday discounts are available online, and some retailers offer exclusive digital promotions. In-store shopping can still be worthwhile for limited-quantity doorbusters or items you want to pick up immediately.
 Is it better to wait for Cyber Monday?
 The line between Black Friday and Cyber Monday has blurred in recent years, and most deals now span both events. However, waiting for Cyber Monday could mean the item you’re hoping to snag on sale sells out, so we generally encourage shoppers to take advantage of any savings sooner rather than later.
 When will Black Friday deals end?
 It’s pretty tough to tell these days. Most sales now roll over into Cyber Monday (which has really become Cyber Week in recent years), and many will continue through Christmas. There’s rarely an official end date, but deals will taper off a bit through December, as many of the most popular items will start to sell out and shipping timeframes make gift shopping impossible.
 How CNET finds the best Black Friday deals
 CNET’s team of deals experts has years of experience scouring the web to find the biggest Black Friday savings on tech, home essentials and more. We compare prices, evaluate product features and consider how items we’ve personally reviewed performed in our rigorous testing to ensure you’re getting the most bang for your buck. Plus, we feature only offers from trusted, legitimate retailers so you can shop with confidence.
